# volcano_password_policy (Data Source)

The platform-wide password policy baseline. A project's volcano_project_auth_config may tighten it further.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_password_policy" "platform" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `compromised_passwords_rejected` (Boolean)
- `effective_min_length` (Number)
- `max_length` (Number)
- `min_configurable_length` (Number)
- `require_lowercase` (Boolean)
- `require_numbers` (Boolean)
- `require_special_chars` (Boolean)
- `require_uppercase` (Boolean)
